executions.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),crypto=require('crypto'),cp=require('child_process');const files=['scripts/electron/npc-composite-waits.cjs','scripts/electron/npc-composite-cases.cjs','web/scripts/smoke-npc-composite-waits.js'];console.log(JSON.stringify({head:cp.execFileSync('git',['rev-parse','HEAD'],{encoding:'utf8'}).trim(),files:files.map(path=>{const b=fs.readFileSync(path);return{path,sha256:crypto.createHash('sha256').update(b).digest('hex'),crlf:(b.toString().match(/\r\n/g)||[]).length}})}));"; git diff --check -- scripts/electron/npc-composite-waits.cjs scripts/electron/npc-composite-cases.cjs web/scripts/smoke-npc-composite-waits.js

implementation.callSite: The final completed-return check waits after the physical return/UI assertions and before the last fixtureErrors/economy assertions and completed-evidence.
implementation.observedSince: startedAt of the last actual completed top-level UI turn, not merely the later barrier start; final-turn failures that occurred just before the barrier are rejected.
durableConditions: latest canonical snapshot exists with GM/P
positive canonical revision equals actual desktop lastSavedRevision
canonical turn and desktop lastSavedTurn equal live turn
campaign/timeline/session/load/turn/transaction identity matches the current canonical world
failureConditions: new or final-turn background failure records
observed canonical/desktop producer rejection or negative result without a legitimate canonical retry/no-write state or the strictly evidenced pre-dispatch desktop supersession described below
implementation.naturalRetry: The helper only awaits existing Promises. A canonical retry already scheduled by production may finish naturally. A clearly stale/deferred/skipped no-write result is recorded and never substitutes for the final durable revision predicate.
implementation.requiredJobBoundary: sc25/sc25c pending/running work is observed until natural settlement. failed/retryable remain explicitly recorded; settlement does not claim these jobs succeeded. Other jobs are also reported and may remain pending.
implementation.stableCompletion: Two identical ready snapshots across an actual requestAnimationFrame boundary; rearmed work or a newer revision resets the match.

machineEvidence.destination: Existing renderer.log console capture, plus final-review-and-save-settled in composite-timeline.json.

fragments.reconstruction: For one observation, sort by part and concatenate payload; JSON.parse produces the complete compact state/producer receipt record.
fragments.reason: bridge-main.cjs truncates individual renderer messages to 2500 characters; the new test proves each fragment fits and reconstruction is exact.

independentReview.finalFragmentHashConfirmation: The 80-test revision hashes were confirmed by /root/final_evidence. No blocking findings in that predicate, producer receipts, shared deadline or fragment format. The subsequent supersession delta is recorded separately below.
independentReview.boundary: Settled means this named review/save scope has no in-flight work and the current revision is saved. It does not assert every historical review is verified or every other job succeeded.

sourceFindings.finding: After a successful native write, a superseded snapshot returns {ok:true,stale:true}; it does not update the current saved revision.
The specific native write-time cross-world failure requires a session token mismatch. Adopting a same-world canonical snapshot alone does not rotate the session.
A queued operation whose snapshot is replaced before dispatch returns a caught DESKTOP_AUTOSAVE_STALE error and sends no native write.

supersessionRevision.observerRule: A negative desktop receipt is retained as negative. It may be marked superseded only for the exact DESKTOP_AUTOSAVE_STALE code, an observed strictly advancing canonical revision, unchanged primitive world and canonical identity, and evidence of a new deferred/flush timer/different in-flight desktop Promise. The final current revision must still receive a genuine durable acknowledgement. No error-message-only exemption exists.

productionFixtureProbe.fixtureBoundary: Runs the production preload/lifecycle functions in the existing local VM fixture. The second case explicitly sets the deferred flag as fixture setup; it does not claim an automatically scheduled replacement write was observed. No real native disk write or model call is made.

independentReview.confirmed: The root agent independently reviewed the typed stale delta and actual production return branches. It accepted the advancing revision, unchanged world/canonical identity and new-flush evidence, while retaining the requirement that the latest revision really be saved. No additional change was requested.

strictTransportRevision.scope: Test-only final background observer; no production save changes, no retry or timeout changes
strictTransportRevision.finding: A full 12-entry transport ring with repeated phase and timestamp could hide an acknowledged event followed by a rejected event. The slice alignment alone did not prove a single appended event.
strictTransportRevision.rule: A negative DESKTOP_AUTOSAVE_STALE receipt is accepted as superseded only after exactly one strictly newer rejected event with unchanged ring alignment. A wrapped ring additionally needs a unique old tail entry; ambiguous histories fail closed. Same-world revision advance, replacement flush and final durable current revision remain required.
